# Orbitto International

> Orbitto International is a food ingredient exporter and manufacturer based in Morbi, Gujarat, India. The company exports fruit powders, vegetable powders, spices, pure honey, and herbal ingredients to importers, distributors, food brands, private label companies, and food manufacturers worldwide. Services include bulk ingredient supply, private label manufacturing, contract manufacturing, third-party manufacturing, and export documentation support.

## Company

- Name: Orbitto International
- Location: Morbi, Gujarat, India (363642)
- Type: Food ingredient exporter, manufacturer, bulk supplier
- Export markets: Worldwide
- Contact: orbittointernational@gmail.com
- Phone: +91 99047 27348

## Product Categories

- Fruit Powder: Spray-dried and dehydrated fruit powders for beverages, bakery, nutraceuticals, and private label. Includes blueberry, mango, amla, guava, and more.
- Vegetable Powder: Dehydrated vegetable powders for soups, seasonings, ready meals, health foods, and industrial food manufacturing. Includes broccoli, beetroot, carrot, spinach, onion, and more.
- Pure Honey: Export-quality raw honey for food brands, retail packing, private label, and global distribution.
- Spices: Premium export spices including red chilli, turmeric, cumin, coriander, garam masala, star anise, cloves, and more for seasoning blends, sauces, and wholesale export.
- Herbal Powder: Cold-processed herbal powders for wellness products, nutraceuticals, and functional beverages. Includes moringa, aloe vera, amla, rose, and more.

## Services

- Bulk Ingredient Supply: High-volume food ingredient supply for industrial buyers and food manufacturers
- Private Label Manufacturing: Custom formulations and branded packaging for food brands entering new markets
- Contract Manufacturing: End-to-end production support for global food brands
- Third-Party Manufacturing: Scalable manufacturing for distributors and nutraceutical companies
- Export Documentation: Full documentation and customs clearance coordination for international buyers
- MOQ and Sample Support: Minimum order quantity guidance and sample supply for new buyers

## Industries Served

Beverages, bakery, confectionery, dairy, ready meals, health foods, nutraceuticals, functional foods, food service, wellness products, snacks, seasonings
